metadata.title: Customer Detail Page with Vaadin Components

story.iWant: view full details of a selected customer including name, email, phone, address, and linked policies
story.soThat: I can understand the customer's complete profile and relationship with the company

tasks.task: Implement CustomerDetailView component with Vaadin routing and URL parameter extraction
Display customer information in read-only Vaadin form (9 fields)
Implement linked policies section with GridPro or Grid component
Add action buttons: Edit Customer, Create Policy, Back, Delete Customer
Implement loading indicator and error state handling
Add breadcrumbs and dynamic page title

requirements.requirement: Page routed to /customers/{id} using Vaadin routing parameter
Calls backend API GET /api/v1/customers/{id}
Displays read-only form with 9 fields: ID, First Name, Last Name, Email, Phone, Address, Status, Created Date, Last Updated Date
Information displayed in clear, organized layout using Vaadin FormLayout or VerticalLayout
Grid showing all policies linked to customer with columns: Policy ID, Type (Motor/Endowment/House/Commercial), Status (Active/Lapsed/Renewed), Premium Amount, Created Date
Clicking policy row navigates to Policy Detail page (Story 3.8)
Display "No policies found for this customer" if customer has no policies
"Edit Customer" button → navigates to Story 3.6 with pre-filled customer data
"Create Policy" button → navigates to policy create with customer pre-selected
"Back" button → returns to Customer Search page (Story 3.4)
"Delete Customer" button → optional, grayed out if customer has active policies
Loading indicator displayed while fetching customer data
Display "Customer not found" message if API returns 404
Display "Unable to load customer, please try again" message on API errors
Linked policies can load asynchronously after customer details
Desktop: 2-column layout (customer details left, policies right)
Tablet/Mobile: 1-column layout (customer details, then policies below)
All text readable and accessible on all screen sizes
Page title updates dynamically (e.g., "John Smith - Customer Details")
Breadcrumbs show path: Dashboard > Customers > John Smith
No horizontal scrolling required on mobile devices

doc.title: Vaadin Project Setup Story
doc.section: Vaadin Spring Boot integration, routing configuration, layout structure
doc.snippet: Vaadin application is already integrated with Spring Boot, using MainLayout as root component with Navigation sidebar. Routing is configured in MainView.

doc.title: Login Page & Spring Security
doc.section: Spring Security configuration, authenticated routes, user context
doc.snippet: Spring Security is integrated. Authenticated users can access Vaadin components. Use SecurityContext to retrieve current user information.

doc.title: Customer Search & List Page
doc.section: Customer API integration, Grid component usage, navigation patterns
doc.snippet: Story 3.4 implements customer search with GET /api/v1/customers endpoint. Uses Vaadin Grid to display results and navigate to detail pages via UI.getCurrent().navigate().

doc.title: Product Requirements Document
doc.section: Customer domain requirements, data model, API specifications
doc.snippet: Customer model includes: id, firstName, lastName, email, phone, address, status, createdDate, updatedDate. Related policies accessible via foreign key relationship.

doc.title: Architecture Document
doc.section: Vaadin Frontend Architecture, API integration patterns, error handling
doc.snippet: Frontend follows Vaadin Component pattern. API calls via Spring RestTemplate or WebClient in backend service layer. Error responses (4xx, 5xx) handled via try-catch with user-friendly messages.

artifact.reason: Root layout component with navigation sidebar. Reference for consistent layout structure and navigation patterns.
Story 3.4 implementation. Reference for Customer Grid, API integration pattern, and navigation to detail page.
Backend endpoints: GET /api/v1/customers/{id} and GET /api/v1/customers/{id}/policies. Must use these endpoints for detail page.
Customer entity model. Contains all fields needed for display: id, firstName, lastName, email, phone, address, status, createdDate, updatedDate.
Policy entity model for linked policies grid. Fields: id, type, status, premiumAmount, createdDate.
Reference for Vaadin routing without parameters. Use @PageTitle, @Route annotations.

constraint.description: Follow Vaadin component-based architecture used in Stories 3.1-3.4. All views extend Composite or View interface.
Use Vaadin @Route annotation with path parameters. Extract customer ID via @RouteParameter or route location handler.
Call backend REST endpoints via Spring's RestTemplate or WebClient configured in service layer. Handle API errors gracefully with try-catch and user-friendly messages.
Use Vaadin built-in components and Lumo theme. No custom CSS required; use component spacing and layout utilities.
Use Vaadin's ResponsiveStep and HorizontalLayout/VerticalLayout for 2-column (desktop) to 1-column (mobile) layout switching. Test on common screen sizes.
Customer details should be displayed in read-only mode. Use TextField with setReadOnly(true) or Text component instead of input fields.
Use UI.getCurrent().navigate() for programmatic navigation. Pass customer ID as route parameter or URL segment.
All API calls must handle exceptions. Display Notification or Dialog with error message. Never expose stack traces to user.

interface.name: GET /api/v1/customers/{id}
interface.signature: GET /api/v1/customers/{id} → {id, firstName, lastName, email, phone, address, status, createdDate, updatedDate}

standards.paragraph: Unit tests use JUnit 5 with Mockito for mocking REST API calls and service layer. Integration tests use Spring @WebMvcTest for controllers and @DataJpaTest for repository layer. Frontend component tests mock the service layer API calls. Error scenarios (404, 500, timeout) are explicitly tested. Acceptance criteria are mapped 1:1 to test methods.
